answers.question: Why do users struggle to discover new music?
answers.finding_summary: Across 40,016 relevant reviews, 19.5% express negative sentiment about music discovery. Dominant themes include Recommendation Quality, Playlist Fatigue, Search & Discovery UX. Users report difficulty finding fresh music beyond familiar playlists and describe recommendations as limited or poorly matched to their taste.
